decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing. The new extract system should as a minimum, and in accordance with good practice, comprise a three-stage system to include a grease, pre-and carbon filter and have the ducting isolated from the building structure, the fan unit should be mounted on anti-vibration mountings, fan silencers should be incorporated and acute bends to the ducting should be minimised.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby approved shall not commence until details of a boundary wall along the road frontage of the rear yard have been submitted to and approved, in writing, by the Local Planning Authority and such approved details shall have been implemented in full.
description: Change of use from (A2) betting office to (A3) caf? use, including the installation of ducting to the rear elevation and the use of the rear area for parking.
